Calculate Performance Metrics from a Validation Result

Source: R/eval_performance_binary.R
eval_performance.Rd

Computes a comprehensive set of discrimination, calibration, and utility performance metrics from the shuffled prediction-outcome matrix returned by secure_model_validation(). Optionally generates diagnostic plots and bootstrap confidence intervals.

Usage

eval_performance(
  validation_result,
  generate_plots = TRUE,
  confidence_intervals = TRUE,
  n_boot = 200,
  plot_title = NULL,
  decision_threshold = 0.1,
  by = NULL,
  cal_args = list(),
  dca_args = list()
)

Arguments

validation_result

List. Output from secure_model_validation().

generate_plots

Logical. Whether to produce calibration, decision curve, and probability distribution plots. Default TRUE.

confidence_intervals

Logical. Whether to compute 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. Default TRUE.

n_boot

Integer. Number of bootstrap resamples. Default 200. Increase to 1000 for publication-quality confidence intervals.

plot_title

Character or NULL. Optional title suffix added to plot headings.

decision_threshold

Numeric. Probability threshold used for net benefit calculations in the decision curve. Default 0.1. Set to the clinically relevant threshold for your outcome.

by

Vector or NULL. Optional subgroup vector of the same length as the predictions (pass result$shuffled_by from the output of secure_model_validation() with the by argument). When provided, metrics are computed separately for each level of this variable.

cal_args

Named list of additional arguments controlling the calibration plot. Supported options:

g

Integer. Number of groups. Default 10.

smooth

Character. Flexible calibration curve method: "loess" (default) or "rcs".

CL.smooth

Whether to show the confidence band around the flexible curve: "fill" (default shaded band), "line", or FALSE to suppress.

xlim

Numeric vector of length 2. X-axis limits. Default c(0, 1).

ylim

Numeric vector of length 2. Y-axis limits. Default c(0, 1).

dca_args

Named list of additional arguments controlling the decision curve analysis. Supported options:

thresholds

Numeric vector. Threshold probabilities at which to evaluate net benefit. Default seq(0, 1, by = 0.01).

standardize

Logical. If TRUE, plot standardised net benefit instead of net benefit. Default FALSE.

policy

Character. "opt-in" (default, treat high-risk patients) or "opt-out" (withhold treatment from low-risk patients).

Value

A named list:

metrics

Data frame of performance metrics. When by is supplied a Subgroup column is prepended.

plots

List of plot objects: calibration, decision_curve, and distribution. When by is supplied, plots are organised by subgroup level: plots[["level_name"]]$calibration, etc.

model_info

Metadata from validation_result.

decision_threshold

The threshold value used.

subgroup_variable

Name of the by variable (subgroup analysis only).

subgroup_categories

Character vector of category names (subgroup analysis only).

Details

Metrics computed include: AUROC/c-statistic, calibration intercept, calibration slope, ECI, ICI, ECE, O:E ratio, Brier score, Nagelkerke R-squared, Cox-Snell R-squared, McFadden R-squared, net benefit, and standardised net benefit.

This function currently supports binary outcomes (0/1) only. Multinomial support is planned for a future release.

See also

secure_model_validation(), list_registered_models()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# ---- Whole-dataset evaluation ----------------------------------------------
dvt_path <- system.file("extdata", "dvt_example.csv", package = "evaluatr")
dvt_val  <- read.csv(dvt_path)
dvt_val  <- dvt_val[dvt_val$study %in% c(6, 7), ]

result <- secure_model_validation(
  repo_owner      = "JoieEnsor",
  repo_name       = "evaluatr-demo-models",
  model_id        = "dvt_logistic_v1",
  github_token    = "evaluatr-demo",
  validation_data = dvt_val,
  outcome         = "dvt"
)

perf <- eval_performance(
  result,
  n_boot             = 200,
  decision_threshold = 0.15
)
perf$metrics

# Access individual diagnostic plots
perf$plots$calibration    # calibration plot
perf$plots$decision_curve # decision curve analysis
perf$plots$distribution   # predicted probability distribution

# ---- Subgroup evaluation by study -----------------------------------------
result_by_study <- secure_model_validation(
  repo_owner      = "JoieEnsor",
  repo_name       = "evaluatr-demo-models",
  model_id        = "dvt_logistic_v1",
  github_token    = "evaluatr-demo",
  validation_data = dvt_val,
  outcome         = "dvt",
  by              = "study"
)

perf_by_study <- eval_performance(
  result_by_study,
  by                 = result_by_study$shuffled_by,
  n_boot             = 200,
  decision_threshold = 0.15
)

# Metrics table has a Subgroup column
perf_by_study$metrics

# Access study-specific plots
perf_by_study$plots[["6"]]$calibration
perf_by_study$plots[["7"]]$calibration

# ---- Customising the calibration plot -------------------------------------
perf_custom <- eval_performance(
  result,
  n_boot             = 200,
  decision_threshold = 0.15,
  cal_args = list(smooth = "rcs", g = 5),
  dca_args = list(standardize = TRUE)
)
} # }
